answer: The echo register is checked at draw time, canyon lists the eligible set, and juniper seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 66 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 66 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. That is 22 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
